sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

By means of this application, the applicant is seeking transfer of Complaint Case No.861 of 2022 (Neeraj @ Gauri v. Sanjeev & ors), under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 DP Act, P.S.- Bahjoi,
District- Sambhal, pending in the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/ J.M., Sambhal to some other district.

entities.text: Court of Civil Judge (J.D.)/ J.M., Sambhal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel contends that the opposite party is obstructing the Advocate representing the accused before the trial court and as a result of that, he is forced to change the lawyer.

Learned counsel has further drawn the attention of the Court to the complaint dated 13.05.2024 by Advocate Nagendra Pal Singh and contended that on the said date when the applicant was pressing for recording the evidence under Section 244 Cr.P.C., the other side caught hold of him and threatened him.
Learned counsel prays that subject trial be transferred from Chandausi to some other district.

After hearing learned counsel and considering his submissions, this Court does not find any merit in this application as the order dated 13.05.2024, simply records that the application seeking Sanjeev And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/87295998/
1 exemption from personal appearance moved by accused Sanjeev has been allowed.

entities.text: Sanjeev And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: That apart, it is also worth noticing that on the said date, no grievance regarding alleged misbehaviour was raised before the trial court.
Concededly the complainant case is pending since 2016, therefore, no exceptional ground is made out for transfer of case.
